card.line: Tarsus was a famous city in Cilicia and the hometown of Saul, who became the apostle Paul. It shows where he came from before God used him.

moments.title: Saul sent home
moments.text: Saul debated with the Grecian Jews in Jerusalem, and they tried to kill him. The brothers took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

moments.title: Barnabas looks for Saul
moments.text: Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul. When he found him, he brought him back to Antioch, and they taught large numbers of people there for a year.

moments.title: Paul names his hometown
moments.text: Paul told a Roman commander that he was a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no ordinary city. He then asked to speak to the people.

moments.title: Born in Tarsus
moments.text: Paul told the crowd in Jerusalem that he was born in Tarsus of Cilicia but raised in Jerusalem. He said he was taught by Gamaliel and was zealous for God.
